title: RF3 MSA/template input-channel audit: structures and analysis-ready features

creators.name: Ding, Cheng
creators.affiliation: School of Life Science and Technology, ShanghaiTech University, Shanghai, China

description: Analysis-ready data for an input-channel audit of RoseTTAFold3. Includes 480 unique E428 sample-level structures, exact E427 row-sliced feature caches, 53 per-arm distogram tensors, and canonical per-run JSON results. This is not the complete raw per-mutant feature library and contains no model checkpoints.
